facts.text: Solar Array & Thermal Sunshade was deployed at Earth-Trailing Heliocentric Orbit during Kepler Space Telescope in 2009.
Curved carbon-composite sunshade and Gallium Arsenide solar array generating 1.1 kW of electrical power while thermally isolating the sensitive photometer at -85°C.
Engineered specifically to operate in the harsh vacuum and extreme temperatures of the lunar environment.
Proved that high-aspect carbon-composite baffle structures could maintain sub-millikelvin thermal stability in interplanetary space.
Status: Remains preserved in the arid regolith at Earth-Trailing Heliocentric Orbit.
A permanent human and robotic monument celebrating space exploration on the Moon.
